newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks dip slightly in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks dip slightly in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were slightly lower in early morning trade on Thursday amid growing worries over the securities sector.
But some high-technology issues were supported by the yen's weaker tendency against the dollar and Wall Street's rally overnight underpinned the market, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average fell 13.10 points or 0.06 percent to 20,199.72 in the first 10 minutes of trade, after opening marginally higher. Its September futures lost 10 points to trade at 20,210.
